records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Labs
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone despite welcome tip [email:71f7a015] and two check-ins [email:70b372d3]; Rafael never replied to any Wrenfield email, only filed one now-closed ticket. One invite sent shows some intent, but silence plus no first project with 8 days left suggests low unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting Blue Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Following up on your bulk import question -- Tariq covered it in that thread: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Happy to pick up anything that's still unclear there.

On setup: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. That first project is usually what makes the rest click.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through creating your first project with you and answer anything else on your list.

Best,
Priya
